messages:
Maya (DemandGen): heads up — Ben and I talked to CloudA today, they want to do a joint webinar + co-post around their marketplace listing. want to align on timeline and inbound routing before we commit.
Ben (Partnerships): they suggested late-Oct. goal: 1) launch blog post on marketplace day 2) 45min webinar (partner-led demo + 15m Q&A) 3) benchmark nugget about latency/cost vs default infra.
Asha (Product Marketing): ok timeline works. need to lock a single benchmark narrative — we should avoid raw benchmarks and frame as 'production economics' (latency at scale + cost per 1M tokens). also want a 2-slide teaser for demand gen.
Diego (Sales Eng): for webinar content I can do a short live demo of Dedicated routing + fallback policy. need partner to commit to a sample workload (their typical 10k qps across 100k tokens/day).
Priya (Comms): PR/blog cadence — plan: embargoed joint blog on marketplace launch day, syndicate to partner channels, then webinar invite 2 weeks after. we need finalized assets 1 week before launch.
Maya (DemandGen): routing question: where do marketplace leads go? we're currently triaging via Pardot -> SFDC. want explicit mapping so partner referrals get SLA treatment.
Sam (Integrations): Sam: we can add a hidden form field on the joint landing page to tag partner_source=cloudA_marketplace. then webhook to Pardot.
Diego (Sales Eng): sample routing mapping — please review:
```
- landing form -> Pardot list: CP_CloudA_Marketplace
- webinar signups -> Pardot list: CP_CloudA_Webinar
- Pardot -> SFDC: Campaign=CloudA_Partner, Lead.Owner=Marketplace_SE_Queue
- high-fit leads (MQL) -> Sales queue + slack #inbound-partner-leads ping
```
Asha (Product Marketing): love that. add UTM params for UTM_source=cloudA and utm_campaign=cloudA_launch. also request: short 2-3 bullet benchmark claim we can repeat in slides and blog.
Ben (Partnerships): I'll ask CloudA for sample traffic and a quote. they also want to co-run a technical rehearsal 3 days prior.
Maya (DemandGen): owners + deadlines checklist:
- Final benchmark narrative (Asha) -> due 10/02
- Landing page + form (Sam) -> due 10/07
- Webinar deck draft (Diego + Asha) -> due 10/10
- Partner assets/quote (Ben) -> due 09/28
- PR/blog draft (Priya) -> due 10/05
Priya (Comms): can we land on messaging pillars now? i propose: 1) predictable production latency, 2) cost efficiency at scale, 3) easy private deploys for regulated customers. short, partner-forward tone.
Asha (Product Marketing): agree. Marketers: keep headline: 'Run production LLMs at predictable latency and lower unit cost — now available via CloudA Marketplace'. copy to iterate.
Ben (Partnerships): CloudA replied: ok to share a short case quote and do joint promo. they want calendar invite for rehearsal.
Maya (DemandGen): @OpsBot can you create a shared calendar event for the rehearsal 3 days before the webinar? include Zoom, rehearsal agenda, and required attendees.
OpsBot: created event "CloudA joint webinar rehearsal" on Oct 19, 11:00-11:45 AM PT. Zoom link: https://zoom.example.com/meet/abc123. Attendees: Maya, Ben, Asha, Diego, CloudA reps.
Diego (Sales Eng): quick question on the benchmark: do we include absolute numbers or percent improvement? percent is safer but partners like absolute baseline. recommend: show both but annotate test conditions.
Asha (Product Marketing): agreed — percent + baseline + test notes. I'll draft two variants for comms review.
Sam (Integrations): implementation note: we'll send Pardot the hidden field and add mapping in our webhook. sample payload:
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{firstName}}",
  "partner_source": "cloudA_marketplace",
  "utm_source": "cloudA",
  "utm_campaign": "cloudA_launch"
}
```
Maya (DemandGen): perfect. Ben — can you confirm partner will include the partner_source on their marketplace redirect?
Ben (Partnerships): spoke to them, they will. also asked for a small co-budget for paid social. waiting on confirmation.
Priya (Comms): next steps for me: draft embargoed blog + joint quote request template. will post drafts in the channel by Friday.
Maya (DemandGen): thanks all. I'll update the shared project board with owners/deadlines and tag people. if anyone needs edits to the routing or messaging call them out here. :thumbsup:
Ben (Partnerships): :thumbsup: good plan.
Asha (Product Marketing): +1.
Diego (Sales Eng): will start deck outline.
Sam (Integrations): will provision webhook and test sandbox by 10/07.
